documents.doc-cz-nss-2026-09-22-6-as-207-2026-26: The Supreme Administrative Court granted the appellant full exemption from the court fee and appointed Mgr. Zuzana Candigliota as counsel in the cassation proceedings. It stated that the cassation complaint cannot be regarded as manifestly unsuccessful without closer examination of the Prague Municipal Court’s reasoning, and set a two-week judicial period for any further supplement by appointed counsel. The order does not decide the merits of the cassation complaint.
